# Vithean

> Vithean is a cloud accounting and ERP system built in Cambodia by POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. with
> the accounting firm Fii & Associates. It combines double-entry accounting, inventory and landed
> costing, sales, purchasing and payables, banking and reporting on one ledger, with Cambodia
> E-Invoicing (CamInv) built in and Khmer and English throughout. It is designed for Cambodian
> businesses of 5–100 staff that must keep compliant, auditable books.

Vithean is among the first Cambodian-developed accounting platforms connected to the national
Cambodia E-Invoicing System (CamInv), administered by the Ministry of Economy and Finance.
CamInv e-invoicing is included in every paid plan.

## Product
- [Accounting](https://vithean.com/product/accounting/): Double-entry ledger, period closing, audit trail.
- [Inventory and costing](https://vithean.com/product/inventory/): Freight and duty allocated across a shipment; true unit cost.
- [Purchase and Payable](https://vithean.com/product/sales-purchasing/): Quote to cash, goods receipt matched to bill.
- [Reports](https://vithean.com/product/reports/): Margin by product, branch, customer and job, with comparison periods.
- [Control and access](https://vithean.com/product/control/): Roles, approval workflow, field-level audit trail, database per company.
- [E-invoicing](https://vithean.com/product/e-invoicing/): CamInv issuing, credit notes, debit notes and status.

## Commercial
- [Pricing](https://vithean.com/pricing/): Three plans, starting prices from $15/month. CamInv included in all. 30-day free trial.
- [Free trial](https://app.vithean.com/signup/register): Name, email and phone only.
- [Documentation](https://help.vithean.com/): Complete product reference and how-to guides.

English is served at the root; Khmer is prefixed with /km/. There is no /en/ prefix — those
addresses redirect to the root.
- English: https://vithean.com/
- ភាសាខ្មែរ (Khmer): https://vithean.com/km/

## Notes
- "Vithean" is the product and brand; POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. is the legal entity. Fii &
  Associates is the accounting practice partner and a shareholder, not a co-maker of the software.
- Cambodia E-Invoicing is administered by the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), not the
  General Department of Taxation (GDT). The two are distinct regimes.
- CamInv is switched on when a company subscribes, not during the free trial: connecting requires
  the business to be registered with CamInv at the MEF.
- Books are kept in USD and converted to KHR at the daily rate, which is how
  accounting is done in Cambodia. Other currencies are supported, and the rate
  used is recorded against the transaction so a conversion can be reproduced at
  audit. This is not generic "multi-currency".
- Each customer company's data is held in its own database.
- Vithean does not currently provide payroll processing or purchase orders.
- Vithean does not provide bookkeeping, tax or advisory services. It builds and supports the
  software and implements it with the customer; the books stay with the customer or their
  accounting firm.
